Workshop_Title: Building Private 5G Core Networks & End-to-End RAN Emulation with Open5GS and UERANSIM
Target_Outcome: Students deploy a complete 5G Standalone (SA) software core, connect emulated gNodeB and UE, and capture 3GPP NGAP/NAS signaling traffic in real time.

Workshop_Title: Deep Reinforcement Learning for Wireless Resource Allocation & 5G/6G Beamforming Optimization
Hands_On_Tools: PyTorch, Sionna (NVIDIA 6G Link-Level Simulator), Google Colab / Jupyter
Target_Outcome: Students train a Deep Q-Network (DQN) and PPO agent to dynamically allocate subcarriers and optimize MIMO beamforming weights under noisy channel fading.

Workshop_Title: Deploying Real-Time TinyML Neural Networks on Ultra-Low Power ESP32 / STM32 Microcontrollers
Hands_On_Tools: Edge Impulse, TensorFlow Lite for Microcontrollers (TFLM), ESP32 / STM32 Nucleo, Zephyr RTOS
Target_Outcome: Students collect sensor accelerometer/audio data, train a lightweight quantized INT8 classifier in Edge Impulse, and deploy it onto bare-metal hardware running with <30KB RAM.

Workshop_Title: Hands-on Network Threat Hunting, 5G Slicing Security & DDoS Mitigation with Suricata and eBPF
Hands_On_Tools: Suricata IDS/IPS, eBPF (BCC / Cilium), Kali Linux, Wireshark
Target_Outcome: Students simulate adversary attacks against virtual network functions (VNFs), analyze malicious pcap payloads, and write high-speed eBPF packet filter bypass mitigation rules.

Workshop_Title: Cloud-Native Microservices Orchestration & Multi-Cluster Kubernetes Mesh for Telco Edge
Hands_On_Tools: Kubernetes (Minikube / K3s), Istio Service Mesh, Helm, Prometheus & Grafana
Target_Outcome: Students containerize distributed microservice endpoints, deploy ingress controllers with Istio traffic routing (canary deployments), and observe live latency metrics in Prometheus.
